summary.headline: Astrological Judgments on War
summary.text: Catalog of astrological chapters on warfare and military judgment, including heralds and truces, tyranny, the place and timing of war, army size, besieged cities, warlike inception, and determining whether someone lives or has died. It then lists material on the four angles, configurations, succedents, applications and separations, trines, squares, oppositions, and sextiles, with references to Codex 7 and the Paris codex.
